text:
maria: follow-up on multi-region cutover: proposing a small lease / handoff surface so proxies can deterministically become write-authoritative during migrations. listing tradeoffs here.
aj: ok, what's the smallest API to start?
maria: POST /lease/claim, POST /lease/release, GET /lease/status. TTL default 30s. proxies try claim before they accept resident writes.
jonathan: scope - per-tenant or per-shard?
maria: per-shard with tenant-set metadata. keeps object counts manageable and allows batch claims.
kate: control-plane partitions worry me. do proxies block?
maria: no blocking. proxies use a short claim deadline (150-200ms). on timeout, behavior is tenant-configurable: (deny-writes, serve-readonly, proxy-forward). default hosted = deny-writes.
devin: races during claim will happen. how do we prevent double-claims?
maria: server uses CAS on a linearizable store and returns a signed lease token: {lease_id, epoch, exp, allowed_shards} signed by control-plane key. proxies present X-Lease-Token header on writes.
aj: signed tokens let proxies validate offline but increase blast radius if leaked.
maria: mitigate with short expiry (45s), bind token to proxy-id and TLS cert, and revocation list.
jonathan: rollback plan?
maria: keep previous region leases valid for a grace window (60-90s) and route a small % of traffic back to old region until metrics converge.
kate: ops needs metrics and runbook.
devin: emit lease_claim_latency_ms, lease_conflict_count, lease_active_count, bundle_refresh_count. audit events: claim, renew, revoke with actor and correlation id.
ops-bot: deploy: lease-service v0.1.0 to staging at 1729991500
aj: staging saw some 409s on racing claims; client should retry with jittered backoff (max 3).
maria: next steps: aj prototype token format, devin add metrics + revoke endpoint, kate draft runbook and dashboard widgets. timeline: prototype end of sprint (2 weeks). I'll draft follow-up RFC with APIs. :thumbsup:
